notes: 'of' is placed on the head noun Σκευᾶ rather than on the indefinite τινος, following rule 21's rule that a determinerless phrase keeps its case preposition with the noun; taking 'of one' whole on τινος remains defensible.
ἀρχιερέως → 'a chief priest' is headed on 'priest', rule 66 naming that very rendering as one whose noun glosses the lexeme.
